description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Contacts' class for a CRM system, including methods for retrieving related records such as opportunities, activities, tickets, and quotes, and managing contact data.

classes.name: Contacts
classes.description: A class representing contact entities in the CRM, with methods for retrieving related records and managing contact data.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of contacts assigned to a specific user.

methods.name: get_contacts1
methods.description: Retrieves contact details for a user with a specific email address (not used elsewhere).

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contacts for a user with pagination (not used elsewhere).

methods.name: process_list_query1
methods.description: Processes a list query and returns results in array format.

methods.name: plugin_process_list_query
methods.description: Processes a list query with security parameters and returns filtered results.

methods.name: get_opportunities
methods.description: Retrieves opportunities related to a contact.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities (tasks, events) related to a contact.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves historical activities (completed or deferred) related to a contact.

methods.name: get_tickets
methods.description: Retrieves tickets related to a contact.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: Retrieves quotes related to a contact.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: Retrieves quotes related to a contact, executing a query that joins quotes with related entities and returns the list.

methods.name: get_salesorder
methods.description: Retrieves related SalesOrder records for a contact, constructing a query joining sales orders with related entities and returning the list.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Retrieves related Products for a contact, executing a query joining products with contact relations and returning the list.

methods.name: get_purchase_orders
methods.description: Retrieves related PurchaseOrder records for a contact, constructing a query joining purchase orders with related entities and returning the list.

methods.name: get_emails
methods.description: Retrieves emails related to a contact, executing a query on activities of type 'Emails' and returning the list.

methods.name: get_campaigns
methods.description: Retrieves campaigns associated with a contact, executing a join query on campaign relations and returning the list.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Retrieves invoices related to a contact, executing a join query on invoices and related entities and returning the list.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to export contact records in CSV format, considering permissions and filters.

methods.name: getColumnNames
methods.description: Retrieves column names for contact fields, used by the Word plugin, considering user permissions.

methods.name: get_searchbyemailid
methods.description: Retrieves contacts with a specific email address, constructing a query with access control.

methods.name: get_contactsforol
methods.description: Retrieves contacts associated with a specific username, constructing a query with permission checks.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles module-specific operations when saving a contact, such as saving attachments.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Uploads and saves file attachments for a contact, managing existing attachments and file uploads.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Moves related records from multiple entity IDs to a target record, updating relation tables accordingly.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates a secondary query part for reports involving related modules.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation table info for related modules based on the secondary module name.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Unlinks all dependent entities of a contact, including potentials, tickets, orders, quotes, and portal info.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Unlinks a contact from another entity/module by removing or updating relation records.

methods.name: getPortalEmailContents
methods.description: Generates email content for portal users, including login info and support details.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves related modules such as Products, Campaigns, and Potentials for a contact.

methods.name: getListButtons
methods.description: Returns list action buttons based on user permissions, such as delete, edit, and send mail.
